title: Networking Foundations: Networking Basics
desc: Foundational overview of network infrastructure, physical topologies, OSI 7-layer model, TCP/IP stack, and essential enterprise services.
modules: Module 1: Exploring Network Types & Topologies (LAN, WAN, WLAN)
Module 2: Network Media & Hardware Components (Switches, Routers, SFPs)
Module 3: OSI & TCP/IP Reference Models (Layers 1-7, TCP 3-Way Handshake)
Module 4: Logical Addressing & Network Protocols (IPv4, MAC, ARP, DNS, DHCP)
Module 5: Modern Enterprise Trends (Cloud Networking, SDN Basics)

title: Learning IP Addressing
desc: Mastering the structure of IPv4 and IPv6 logical addresses, binary-to-decimal conversion, address classes, and RFC 1918 private spaces.
modules: Module 1: IPv4 Structure & Binary Essentials (32-bit math, octet boundaries)
Module 2: Address Classes & RFC 1918 Private Ranges (10.0.0.0, 172.16.0.0, 192.168.0.0)
Module 3: Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR prefix notations /8 to /32)
Module 4: Special Use Addresses (Loopback 127.0.0.1, APIPA, Broadcast)
Module 5: Introduction to IPv6 Addressing (128-bit hex, zero compression, EUI-64)

title: Learning Subnetting
desc: Rapid mental and mathematical subnetting techniques, calculating block sizes, usable host ranges, and Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM).
modules: Module 1: The Mathematics of Subnetting (Powers of 2, 2^n subnets, 2^h - 2 hosts)
Module 2: Subnetting Class C Networks (/24 to /30, point-to-point links)
Module 3: Subnetting Class B and Class A Networks (Multi-octet borrowing)
Module 4: Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM hierarchical IP design)
Module 5: Mental Speed Subnetting Shortcuts (Finger method, chart-free CIDR hacks)

title: Cisco Networking Foundations: IP Addressing
desc: Hands-on implementation of IPv4 and IPv6 on Cisco IOS routers and Catalyst switches, including SVI management and loopback interfaces.
modules: Module 1: Cisco IOS Interface IP Configuration (ip address command, no shutdown)
Module 2: Secondary IP Addresses & Loopback Interfaces (Stability testing)
Module 3: IPv6 Interface Configuration (Static assignment, EUI-64 link-local)
Module 4: Address Verification on Cisco IOS (ping, traceroute, show ip int br)

title: Cisco Networking Foundations: Fundamentals of Cisco Networking
desc: Cisco hardware architecture, IOS CLI navigation modes, baseline switch and router hardening, and neighbor discovery via CDP and LLDP.
modules: Module 1: Cisco Enterprise Hardware Ecosystem (Catalyst 9000, ISR 4000)
Module 2: Cisco IOS CLI Navigation (User EXEC, Privileged EXEC, Global Config)
Module 3: Baseline Device Hardening (Hostname, passwords, banners, saving config)
Module 4: Neighbor Discovery Protocols (CDP, LLDP topology mapping)

title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA 200-301) v1.1 Cert Prep
desc: The flagship, 201-lesson master curriculum covering all official Cisco 200-301 v1.1 exam domains from switching to security, OSPF, and automation.
modules: Module 1: Foundational Networking Technologies (25 Lessons)
Module 2: IPv4 Addressing & Subnetting (21 Lessons)
Module 3: IPv6 Addressing (17 Lessons)
Module 4: Ethernet Switching (38 Lessons)
Module 5: Routing (22 Lessons)
Module 6: Wireless Networks (13 Lessons)
Module 7: Network Services (23 Lessons)
Module 8: Network Security (27 Lessons)
Module 9: Network Programmability (10 Lessons)
Module 10: Exam Preparation & Practice (3 Lessons)

title: Cisco Networking Foundations: Switching and Routing
desc: Deep dive into Layer 2 switching operations, CAM/MAC tables, 802.1Q trunks, Spanning Tree loop avoidance, EtherChannel, and packet routing.
modules: Module 1: Ethernet Switching Deep Dive (Frame format, CAM table flooding)
Module 2: VLANs & 802.1Q Trunking (Access vs Trunk, Native VLAN)
Module 3: Spanning Tree Protocol Operations (Root election, port states)
Module 4: EtherChannel Link Aggregation (LACP, PAgP, load balancing)
Module 5: IP Routing & Packet Forwarding (Packet flow, Static routes, RIP/RIPng)

title: Cisco Networking Foundations: Wireless, Services, Security & Virtualization
desc: Enterprise wireless LAN architecture, Cisco WLCs, DHCP relay, NAT/PAT translation pools, ACL traffic filtering, and network virtualization.
modules: Module 1: Cisco Wireless Architecture (Autonomous vs Lightweight APs, WLCs)
Module 2: Network Infrastructure Services (DHCP server & relay, NAT/PAT)
Module 3: Basic Network Security & ACLs (Standard & Extended ACL syntax)
Module 4: Network Virtualization & Cloud Integration (Virtual switching, VRF-Lite)

title: Wireless Networking Essential Training
desc: Radio frequency principles, 802.11 standards from Wi-Fi 4 through Wi-Fi 7, spectrum channel planning, and WPA2/WPA3 enterprise encryption.
modules: Module 1: Radio Frequency (RF) Principles (Antennas, signal attenuation, SNR)
Module 2: 802.11 Standards Evolution (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be)
Module 3: Spectrum Management (2.4 GHz channels 1, 6, 11, 5 GHz DFS, 6 GHz)
Module 4: Wireless Security & Authentication (WPA2-Enterprise, WPA3 SAE)
Module 5: Troubleshooting Wireless Issues (Co-channel interference, hidden nodes)

title: Cisco Certified Support Technician (CCST) Networking Cert Prep
desc: Cisco official entry-level support technician cert prep focusing on physical connectivity, host IP diagnostics, and structured ticket triage.
modules: Module 1: Standards and Concepts (Core definitions, bandwidth vs throughput)
Module 2: Addressing & Subnet Formats (Default gateways, broadcast boundaries)
Module 3: Endpoints and Media Types (Host adapter properties, RJ-45, fiber)
Module 4: Infrastructure Diagnostics (ping, tracert, nslookup, arp, netstat)
Module 5: Structured Troubleshooting Methodology (7-step triage approach)

title: Cisco Certified Support Technician (CCST) Cybersecurity Cert Prep
desc: Cybersecurity principles, CIA triad, threat vectors, stateful perimeter defense, multi-factor authentication, and security incident response.
modules: Module 1: Security Principles (CIA triad, least privilege, threat vs vulnerability)
Module 2: Threat Landscape (Malware, phishing, man-in-the-middle, DDoS)
Module 3: Network Defense Fundamentals (Stateful inspection, DMZ, IDS/IPS)
Module 4: Endpoint Security & Access Management (MFA, certificates, VPNs)
Module 5: Incident Handling & Compliance (SIEM alerts, containment phases)

title: Cisco CCNP Enterprise: ENCOR (350-401) Cert Prep: 1 Architecture, Virtualization, Network Assurance, and Security
desc: Enterprise core architecture, Cisco SD-Access, SD-WAN controllers, network telemetry (NetFlow, SPAN, IP SLA), and enterprise security (TrustSec, CoPP).
modules: Module 1: Enterprise Campus Architecture (2-tier vs 3-tier, Spine-Leaf)
Module 2: Cisco Software-Defined Access (Underlay vs overlay, LISP, VXLAN)
Module 3: Cisco SD-WAN Architecture (vManage, vSmart, vBond, vEdge)
Module 4: Network Virtualization (Hypervisors, VNFs, VRF-Lite)
Module 5: Network Assurance & Telemetry (NetFlow, ERSPAN, IP SLA, DNA Center)
Module 6: Enterprise Security Hardening (TrustSec, 802.1X ISE, MACsec, CoPP)

title: Cisco CCNP Enterprise: ENCOR (350-401) Cert Prep: 2 Infrastructure and Automation
desc: Advanced enterprise switching (MSTP), multi-area OSPFv3, enterprise BGP path selection, high availability (VRRP/BFD), and Python automation.
modules: Module 1: Advanced Layer 2 Switching (MSTP, Root Guard, BPDU Filtering)
Module 2: Advanced OSPFv2 and OSPFv3 (Multi-area, LSA types 1-7, summarization)
Module 3: Enterprise BGP Routing (eBGP, Weight, Local Pref, AS-Path, MED)
Module 4: Network Redundancy & IP Services (VRRPv3, GLBP, BFD sub-second)
Module 5: Network Automation & Programmability (Python Netmiko, YANG, RESTCONF)

title: Cisco CCNP Enterprise: ENARSI (300-410) Cert Prep: Layer 3 Technologies
desc: Advanced enterprise routing, complex mutual route redistribution, route maps, prefix lists, policy-based routing, and deep BGP customer multi-homing.
modules: Module 1: Complex IPv4 and IPv6 Routing (EIGRP named, OSPF virtual links)
Module 2: Advanced Route Redistribution (OSPF to BGP, route tagging loops)
Module 3: Route Filtering & Policy-Based Routing (Prefix lists, route maps, PBR)
Module 4: Deep-Dive BGP Operations (BGP communities, multi-homed customer failover)

title: Cisco CCNP Enterprise: ENARSI (300-410) Cert Prep: VPN Technologies and Infrastructure Security
desc: Enterprise WAN VPNs including DMVPN Phase 1/2/3, MPLS Layer 3 VPN fundamentals, Control Plane Policing (CoPP), and TACACS+/RADIUS AAA server integration.
modules: Module 1: Enterprise VPN Technologies (DMVPN, NHRP, IPsec tunnel protection)
Module 2: MPLS Layer 3 VPN Fundamentals (P, PE, CE roles, Route Targets/Distinguishers)
Module 3: Infrastructure Security & CoPP (Control Plane Policing CPU protection)
Module 4: Enterprise Device Hardening (TACACS+/RADIUS AAA, SSH key security, SNMPv3)
